Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro and next steps — VP/CTO alignment + technical deep dive

Hi Oliver —

Thanks again for the great conversation earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps to keep momentum: 

- Summary: Acme Health is exploring a pilot to reduce inference costs and improve latency for your clinical summarization pipeline. You indicated interest in both a quick proof-of-concept (3–4 week) and an evaluation of private deployment options for PHI workflows.
- Immediate ask: we’d like to schedule a short executive alignment call (VP/CTO) so your leadership can meet our head of product/CTO to confirm timelines and success criteria.
- Follow-up: after exec alignment, we’ll do a 60–90 minute technical deep dive (SE + infra) to map integration, performance targets, and security controls.

Proposed windows next week for the VP/CTO intro (30 min):
- Tue 18 May: 10:00–10:30 PT
- Wed 19 May: 14:00–14:30 PT
- Thu 20 May: 09:00–09:30 PT

If those don’t work, send a couple of times that do and we’ll accommodate. I’ve attached a short PoC plan that outlines objectives and timeline.

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood-poc-plan.pdf]

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (650) 555-0132

--
Redwood Inference — production-first LLM inference

1) Architecture overview & integration options (hosted API vs dedicated vs private)
2) Performance targets (latency, throughput, token cost) and benchmarking plan
3) Security & compliance touchpoints (VPC, KMS, audit logs)
4) PoC timeline and responsibilities

I’ve attached a short agenda for the deep dive. Proposed exec intro slot: Tue 18 May, 10:00–10:30 PT — I’ll block calendar tentatively. If that works for Vikram I’ll follow up with a calendar invite for all attendees and include an invite for the 90-minute technical session (TBD).
